      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Enforces bounds checking on numeric configuration options to prevent integer wrap-around and silent logic errors at startup. Rejecting invalid arguments and preventing silent misconfigurations provides clear value for node operators, though it is reasonably deferrable."
